description: How booked the next working days are: for each day, open worker minutes inside shop hours (and each worker's own hours) minus time off, booked minutes, percent booked, and how many visits of visit_minutes (default 120) still fit, counted the way schedule.findTime offers times. Give person_ids to check some workers. A field worker sees only themselves. Read only.

from.description: First day, in the shop's time zone. Default today there.

name: schedule_capacity

next_actions.description: Up to 3 useful next steps, best first, in plain words. op names the op to call, when there is one. when is now, later, check, or tell_human. due_at is set for later and check when there is a natural time. A send is tell_human: show the owner the draft, then send only when they say so.
